gen-tourney-gf-hind-vadodara: Stretched, stocky and sporty, Tourney charges in first. Hind Vadodara takes over as a rounded, spacious sans, its big open e and a giving all that bulk somewhere to rest.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart. Tourney hits hard with blunt, uniform strokes and wide tracking, while the body's tall, full lowercase c, s and z do the quiet, easy work.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-anatolian-hiero: Blunt as a marker tip, and loud with it. Tourney does swagger best; Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs does tidy, modern work, its lowercase rising close to cap height.
gen-fs-oswald-fs-quicksand: Tightly knit and sure of itself, Oswald takes the lead. It packs rows tight and strong, while Quicksand draws soft, uninterrupted monoline strokes and rounded, bulb-like lowercase bowls.
